projects.title: WISE — Web Integrated Search Engine
projects.description: Architected a highly scalable hybrid RAG system handling over 15,000 corporate filings. Engineered a querying engine routing between vector search and NL-to-SQL, returning context-aware answers with low latency.

projects.title: AI-Based Corporate Filings Parser

projects.title: Podcast Generation Engine
projects.description: Developed an automated B2B TTS pipeline transforming executive briefings into multi-speaker podcasts. Features contextual abbreviation expansion and artifact-free audio cloning.
